description: Get metadata for a project item. Returns bounded parsed fields by default; GPS, serials, and personal contact/author fields are omitted. Raw packets require explicit include_project_metadata/include_xmp_metadata and include_sensitive true. Media paths require include_media_path true. Project metadata XML and file/clip XMP are separate packets; disable either when identity/path is enough. Prefer inspect_project_panel_metadata_uxp item_columns or manage_metadata_uxp inspect_fields for visible columns. This is not the premiere://project/metadata resource. GPS and serials are omitted from parse_fields unless include_sensitive is true.

expected_cep_target.description: Optional reviewed CEP sequence/clip identity and exact tick ranges. Checked before every generated command; UXP refuses this CEP-only guard.

effect.description: Reviewed effect and parameter identity checked before mutation.

match_name.description: Effect match name from host inspection.

end_ticks.description: Exact expected exclusive timeline end ticks.

out_ticks.description: Exact expected exclusive source Out ticks.

track_index.description: Expected zero-based track index; identity still checked.

project_document_id.description: Exact Premiere project document ID observed during review.

source_item.description: Reviewed source identity for a source-only operation.

expected_project_path.description: Optional absolute saved-project path. Every generated CEP command refuses before its body when the active project differs or is unsaved. UXP commands refuse this CEP-only guard; local-only tools do not inspect Premiere. Omit to keep existing behavior.

include_media_path.description: Opt in to the full source media path, which can identify the local user and folders; default false.

include_project_metadata.description: Opt in to raw Project Metadata XML (maximum 256 Ki characters). Requires include_sensitive true; default false. Set false to skip reading this packet entirely.

include_sensitive.description: Opt in to sensitive GPS, serial, author, and contact fields. Required for any raw packet; default false.

include_xmp_metadata.description: Opt in to raw XMP XML (maximum 256 Ki characters). Requires include_sensitive true; default false. Set false to skip reading this packet entirely.

item_id.description: Node ID or name of the project item

parse_fields.description: Parse project metadata and XMP into named fields (default true). Set false for identity-only or explicitly requested raw packets.

name: get_metadata

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

idempotency.description: Present when idempotency_key deduplicated this call: replayed is true when the original outcome was returned instead of running again.

receipt.description: Versioned common mutation receipt; success never implies rendered verification.

title: Get Metadata
